de15_masters.topic: Blake Masters, Saving Arizona and the parallel with Vance (2021-2024)

claims.text: Masters: born 5 Aug 1986; Stanford BA 2008, JD 2012; his notes of Thiel's spring 2012 class became Zero to One (Sept 2014, co-written); COO of Thiel Capital and president of the Thiel Foundation; resigned both March 2022; Thiel seeded Saving Arizona with $10m in 2021 and added $3.5m in May 2022; primary 2 Aug 2022 Masters ~40%; lost to Kelly by 4.9 points; 2024 lost AZ-8 GOP primary to Abe Hamadeh after Trump endorsed both; named Kaczynski as an 'underrated subversive thinker' (March 2022) while not endorsing the bombings
Federalist 26 Apr 2021: Thiel gave $10 million to Saving Arizona, formed that April to unseat Kelly; Masters then president of the Thiel Foundation and COO of Thiel Capital

AP 2 Jun 2022: Trump endorsed Masters, calling him a 'great modern-day thinker'; Masters had risen to COO of Thiel Capital and president of the Thiel Foundation; co-wrote Zero to One; said 'I think Trump won in 2020'
NBC (late July 2022): Saving Arizona 'has received over $13 million from Thiel alone' (FEC); Thiel gave over $14 million to Protect Ohio Values (FEC); Masters COO of Thiel Capital per LinkedIn

CNBC 20 Sep 2022: Thiel gave $15m to Saving Arizona and $15m to Protect Ohio Values across the primaries, last donations July and April respectively; none for the general so far; to host a fundraiser 30 Sept at his home; Thiel at NatCon: 'My scoring on the '22 cycle is we are doing even less well than '94'
Axios 20 Sep 2022: SLF cancelled $9.6m of Arizona TV reservations; Thiel had not personally donated to Saving Arizona since the primary

Axios 12 Oct 2022: Thiel offered SLF a matching arrangement (at least $10m combined, Thiel half); Thiel had earlier rejected splitting general-election costs, citing early-cycle investments and concern the spending would become a Democratic talking point (WaPo); Thiel signalled he was done spending for Vance (CNBC); Kelly raised $52m through June vs about $5m for Masters
CNBC 15 Oct 2022: through Q3 Kelly had raised over $52m and Masters just under $5m; Uihlein ($3m) and the Winklevoss twins ($1m) gave to Saving Arizona
CNBC 12 Nov 2022: Thiel spent $32m in the midterms; $15m to the pro-Vance super PAC in the primary and none in the general; $15m to the pro-Masters super PAC in the primary plus $2.5m in October
12News: Thiel's $15m was 92% of Saving Arizona's funding (FEC)
ProPublica: Saving Arizona total receipts $21,591,017 and independent expenditures $25,458,284 in the 2022 cycle
Arizona 2022: GOP primary 2 Aug Masters 40.24%, Lamon 28.10%, Brnovich 17.72%; general 8 Nov Kelly 51.39%, Masters 46.51%; Kelly raised $75m, Masters $12m
The FEC sent Saving Arizona a letter over 48-hour reporting of independent expenditures; Thiel had given $10m by then; CLC: a standard notification

de15_coordination.topic: Coordination complaint against Protect Ohio Values and the Vance campaign (MUR 8009)

claims.text: 6 Jun 2022: CLC complaint alleged Protect Ohio Values gave the Vance campaign polling data, voter-targeting information and draft communications free through a website hidden from the public, and that the campaign used a PAC script for an ad

FEC MUR 8009 (complainants CLC, End Citizens United PAC, Roger Wieand): complaint alleged POV PAC spent over '$1 million on polling and voter-targeting information' given free via a website; 'The Commission dismissed the allegations in light of the public nature of the communications at issue'; Vice Chair Weintraub issued a statement of reasons (digest of 24 May 2024)
